data.exact_reserve_text: Net reserves for claims outstanding at 31 December 2015 were reduced by GBP 57.6m in calendar year 2016. Net reserves for claims outstanding at 31 December 2014 were reduced by GBP 32.4m in calendar year 2015.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2012 and 2013 years experienced natural catastrophe losses totalling GBP 26.8m which impacted underwriting results for those years.

Potential change in the Ogden discount rate for lump sum personal injury awards; Directors' best estimate is 1.0% and a move to 0.0% is projected to have an adverse impact of GBP 26.7m on the current best estimate.

named_events.loss_description: The 2016 year was impacted by the Alberta wildfire natural catastrophe with losses of GBP 12.0m.
The 2016 year was impacted by Hurricane Matthew with losses of GBP 5.9m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net release from prior year reserves of GBP 57.6m in calendar year 2016 driven primarily by more favourable claims development and effective claims handling and collection of reinsurance recoveries. The balance sheet was affected by the acceptance of an RITC from Syndicate 1400 which increased gross reserves and complicates direct comparisons. Sensitivity remains around motor casualty reserves linked to the Ogden discount rate review (potential adverse impact noted).
raw_causal_phrases: release from prior year reserves of GBP 57.6m
more favourable claims development than originally anticipated
the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (insurance liabilities) figure was found. The report explicitly states a net release of GBP 57.6m; per extraction rules this NET figure was used as a fallback. A RITC from Syndicate 1400 was accepted 1 Jan 2016 and the claims tables were restated to include historical information for that RITC; this may distort direct interpretation of triangle-based gross movements. The gross claims development triangle is present and restated, but because RITC adjustments occurred and no explicit gross PYD line was provided, the net figure was chosen as the authoritative disclosed movement and flagged accordingly.
